from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,hashlib
base=Path.cwd();task=base/'.local/tool-tasks/pruning-outcome-proof-20261007';dll=task/'build-native-v7/CombatSolver.dll'
for label,scene in [('plain-v7','PRUNING-OUTCOME-DOMINANCE'),('regen-v7','PRUNING-OUTCOME-DOMINANCE-REGEN')]:
 out=task/('native-'+label);out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 cmd=['bash','tools/testing/run-unattended-test.sh','--scenario-id',scene,'--character-id','NECROBINDER','--encounter-id','NIBBITS_WEAK','--seed','PRUNING-OUTCOME-DOMINANCE-20261007','--combat-solver-build-dir',str(dll.parent),'--headless-instance','pruning-outcome-'+label+'-20261007','--timeout-seconds','120','--evidence-directory',str(out),'--cleanup-instance-on-exit','--exit-on-complete']
 (task/('native-'+label+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'dllSha256':hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2)+'\n')
 with (task/('native-'+label+'.log')).open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 d=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text()) if (out/'result.json').exists() else {}
 print(label,r.returncode,{k:d.get(k) for k in ['runId','status','elapsedMilliseconds','completedChecks','error']},flush=True)
 if r.returncode!=0 or d.get('status')!='Passed':raise SystemExit(1)
